study: M8 pregame prior formation mix × Crown AH pricing; historical event-time replay
crown_path_and_T12_data_source: R25 M8 historical Crown T12 AH source-event cohort; event prices are historical replays, not actual HTTP receipt quotes

methodology.formation_input: Past completed matches in source games.csv.gz; for each team within prior 365 days, three-back/four-back/five-plus formation shares and normalized Shannon entropy; prior-90-day shifts in three-back and five-plus shares; date-only cutoff target date minus 3 days. Target fixture formation never used.
methodology.features: market_only: Crown market-implied margin, AH line, two-price skew; formation_only: fixed symmetric home-away sum/difference and recent-shift features; market_plus_formation: their concatenation.
methodology.time_forward: 2024 train 2019-2023; 2025 train 2019-2024; 2026 train 2019-2025; train only common-feature rows earlier than target year and exclude actual receipt FIDs.
methodology.model: Fixed Ridge alpha=100, fold-local standardization, Gaussian integer goal-difference approximation using training RMSE; choose the AH side with higher expected Crown net return. No EV no-bet filter or parameter search.
methodology.settlement: Crown AH original T12 line and both decimal odds; quarter-lines split into two adjacent half-goal legs and settled separately at half stake.

actual_receipt_replay.formation_feature_time_status: Retrospective Formation dataset rows precede each target by date, but first-publication/receipt timestamps are absent; these rows are receipt-price replay with non-verified contemporaneous feature acquisition.
